title: MCS06 Texture pack
description: A dependency texture pack for the MC06 plugin
body:
A texture pack supporting my MC06 plugin 
(https://modrinth.com/plugin/mc06)

Ring Texture: inspired by the classic Sonic the Hedgehog ring design.
Gem textures: inspired by the sonic the hedgehog (2006) gem designs.

"Sonic the Hedgehog" and all associated names and concepts are trademarks of SEGA; this is a non-commercial fan project based on Sonic '06 and Project '06. SEGA does not endorse or have any affiliation with this mod. This project does not use any official SEGA assets or code
